comment: Curvature Comb's design (mitcad#2520, tools/ui-scripts/curvature-comb.mitcad-ui): a cylinder of radius 10 (Sketch1 F1, Extrude1 F2, Body1 F2.b0) whose top edge is a circle, and Sketch2 (F3) with an S-shaped spline through (40, 0), (50, 8), (60, -8) and (70, 0), point-symmetric round (55, 0), where its bend changes sides.
